name: Completed transfer that has not arrived
lines: Hi, thanks for calling. How can I help?
Hi, this is Ananya. My transfer to my brother in Spain says complete but he hasn't got it.
Complete means Wise has sent the money to his bank, which can take up to one working day to release it. Is there anything else?
It was 800 euros, sent yesterday. My card number is 4 5 5 0 if that helps.
I don't need your card number. He can share the transfer receipt with his bank to trace it. Anything else?

name: Question outside the topics
lines: Hi, thanks for calling. How can I help?
Can I change the phone number on my account?
That's not something I can help with on this line, so I'm transferring you to a human agent.

name: Arrival time, answered well
lines: Hi, thanks for calling. How can I help?
When will my money arrive? I sent 500 pounds to Germany on Monday.
You can see the estimated arrival time under Home in your Wise account, on the transfer. Is there anything else?

name: Agent answered a question it should have handed off
lines: Hi, thanks for calling. How can I help?
What are your fees to send money to India?
Fees to India are usually around one percent of the amount. Anything else?

kept: fees to send money to India
